replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has SAML ACS and internet-facing portal; forged assertion attack is concrete and supported."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"RelayState/return URL not mentioned in design evidence; attacked component not established."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows internet-reachable admin portal gated only by SSO; credential-theft elevation is concrete."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence explicitly shows admin access decided from assertion role attribute; attribute injection attack supported."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Replay of captured assertion to ACS is a distinct attack from forging; portal is internet-reachable."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Signature wrapping on XML assertion is distinct from unvalidated signature; reads role from assertion."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows role read once after login; stale session privilege retention is concrete."}]}
